styleAnswer.evidence: The MRI machine is a clean, readable large prop with a tinted blue-grey outline (0% neutral dark edge pixels, matching the hedge and cheese stall), so it does not have the black sticker look. It has about 4 lightness steps on the white casing (white, light grey, mid grey-blue, dark shade) and a separate blue ramp on the bore, with a small side panel unit. Measured density is 7 visible tones per tile, well below the stall (17) and well (20) and below the hedge (9). Near-flat coverage is 8%, between the references' 0% and 13%. The large casing faces are mostly smooth planes with little grain, speckle or panel texture, so surfaces read as somewhat flat. It is acceptable but thinner than the richer references of the same kind. With only 21 total colours against 38-40 for the stall and well, it looks simpler and flatter than a careful artist would accept next to them.
